[[File:Facade San Giovanni in Laterano 2006-09-07.jpg|thumb|300px|San Giovanni in Laterano]]
'''Esquilino''' and '''San Giovanni''' are adjacent neighborhoods in [[Rome]].

'''Esquilino''' is named for the Esquiline hill on which it stands. It lies south of the Termini station and is centred more or less on the Piazza Vittorio Emmanuele II. It is now partly a Chinese immigrant neighbourhood, and specialty groceries and shoe stores abound. '''San Giovanni''' is named after the Basilica, which is the Roman Catholic cathedral of Rome. The area is south-east of the Esquiline.

Metro Line A connects {{marker|type=go|name=Termini|wikidata=Q754485}} {{rint|rome|a}} {{rint|rome|c}} station with the basilica of San Giovanni. There are also several buses from the downtown area, best caught at Piazza Venezia or at {{marker|type=go|name=Colosseo|wikidata=Q1229235}} {{rint|rome|b}} {{rint|rome|c}} station by the Colosseum, where you can connect with Metro Line B.

Porta Maggiore can be considered the '''tram hub of Rome''', with four of the city's six remaining tram lines passing through. As such, any place in Rome that has a tram stop is connected to Porta Maggiore directly or with just one transfer.

==See==
* {{see
| name=Santa Maria Maggiore | alt= | url=http://www.vatican.va/various/basiliche/sm_maggiore/index_fr.html | email=
| address=Via Liberiana 27 | lat=41.8975 | long=12.498611 | directions=
| phone=+39 06483195 | tollfree=
| hours= | price=
| wikipedia=Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore | image=Santa maria maggiore 051218-01.JPG | wikidata=Q186282
| content=Built in the 9th century, this ancient basilica crowns the top of the Esquiline Hill. Tons of gold decorate the interior together with impressive mosaics (particularly when the floodlights are turned on), and there is a museum on the premises. If you are in Rome on Corpus Christi (Corpus Domini), which is the Thursday after the 8th Sunday after Easter, an early-evening service is held in San Giovanni by the Pope followed by a procession along Via Merulana to Santa Maria. Good opportunity for a close up view of the Pope. <br /><br />This is a very large church with lots to see, as for example, the main part of the church has two layers of mosaics and paintings high on the walls, the altar and apse are spectacular, and then there are several more or less large chapels you won't want to miss, including the one with the amazing golden baptismal font. Allow at least an hour if not an hour and a half or more to visit the interior, even if you do not take any special tours, and also allow time to view the exterior from all sides. Overall, at least 2 hours would not be too much time to allot.
}}

| content=This is the cathedral church of Rome and first of the major basilicas. It's also the Pope's (as Bishop of Rome) Church. As such it ranks above all other churches in the Roman Catholic Church, even above St. Peter's. Be sure to check out the 4th-century baptistery (still in use - in Piazza di San Giovanni, slightly apart from the main basilica) and the medieval cloister (brilliant Cosmati columns)

==Do==
Movies are shown and some performances are held for free in Piazza Vittorio during the summer.

==Buy==
* {{buy
| name=Mercato Esquilino | alt= | url= | email=
| address= | lat=41.89579 | long=12.50612 | directions=
| phone= | tollfree= | fax=
| hours= | price=
| content=An indoor market of ancient provenance that has moved from its longtime outdoor home all the way round the outside of Piazza Vittorio; it is still only a couple of blocks east of the piazza. The mercato is divided into a food section, with good and cheap produce, meat, and fish, and a clothing section, with clothes of all kinds, shoes, luggage, etc., at low prices and generally not fabulous quality. Get there in the morning for food; it's generally closed by afternoon.
}}

Their marketing says they are a pub, perhaps to pull in tourists hankering after home but this is an Italian restaurant.  The waiters hustle passers by into becoming satisfied diners. The white table cloths, linen and cutlery are presentable.  The menu is varied and does not stress pizza, though they do have it.  There are a variety of meat and fish dishes and pasta.
